Hardcoded Credentials ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://admin:SuperSecret123@localhost/prod" API_KEY = "sk-1234567890abcdef" # ✅ FIXED - Use environment variables import os from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv() DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL") API_KEY = os.getenv("API_KEY") if not DATABASE_URL: raise EnvironmentError("DATABASE_URL not configured") ``` ### 3. Broken Authentication ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE - Weak password hashing import md5 hashed = md5.new(password).hexdigest() # ❌ VULNERABLE - No rate limiting on login @app.route("/login", methods=["POST"]) def login(): user = authenticate(request.form["username"], request.form["password"]) # ✅ FIXED - Strong hashing + rate limiting import bcrypt from flask_limiter import Limiter limiter = Limiter(app, key_func=get_remote_address) def hash_password(password: str) -> bytes: return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12)) def verify_password(password: str, hashed: bytes) -> bool: return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode("utf-8"), hashed) @app.route("/login", methods=["POST"]) @limiter.limit("5 per minute") def login(): username = request.form.get("username", "").strip() password = request.form.get("password", "") user = authenticate(username, password) ``` --- ## 🟠 High Severity Issues ### 4. Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) ```javascript // ❌ VULNERABLE document.getElementById("output").innerHTML = userInput; element.innerHTML = `
${userData.name}
`; // ✅ FIXED - Use textContent or sanitize document.getElementById("output").textContent = userInput; // For HTML content, use a sanitizer import DOMPurify from "dompurify"; element.innerHTML = DOMPurify.sanitize(userInput, { ALLOWED_TAGS: ["b", "i", "em", "strong"], ALLOWED_ATTR: [], }); ``` ### 5. Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE - No ownership check @app.route("/documents/") @login_required def get_document(doc_id): doc = Document.query.get(doc_id) return jsonify(doc.to_dict()) # ✅ FIXED - Verify ownership @app.route("/documents/") @login_required def get_document(doc_id): doc = Document.query.filter_by( id=doc_id, owner_id=current_user.id # Ownership check ).first_or_404() return jsonify(doc.to_dict()) ``` ### 6. Insecure File Upload ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE @app.route("/upload", methods=["POST"]) def upload(): file = request.files["file"] file.save(f"uploads/{file.filename}") # Path traversal + no validation # ✅ FIXED import os import uuid from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "pdf"} MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024 # 5MB def allowed_file(filename: str) -> bool: return ( "." in filename and filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower() in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS ) @app.route("/upload", methods=["POST"]) @login_required def upload(): if "file" not in request.files: return jsonify({"error": "No file provided"}), 400 file = request.files["file"] # Validate size file.seek(0, 2) if file.tell() > MAX_FILE_SIZE: return jsonify({"error": "File too large"}), 413 file.seek(0) # Validate extension if not allowed_file(file.filename): return jsonify({"error": "File type not allowed"}), 400 # Validate MIME type (not just extension) import magic mime = magic.from_buffer(file.read(1024), mime=True) file.seek(0) if mime not in ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "application/pdf"]: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid file content"}), 400 # Generate safe, random filename ext = secure_filename(file.filename).rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower() safe_filename = f"{uuid.uuid4()}.{ext}" # Store outside web root upload_path = os.path.join(app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"], safe_filename) file.save(upload_path) return jsonify({"filename": safe_filename}), 200 ``` ### 7. Sensitive Data Exposure in Logs ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE import logging logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) def process_payment(card_number, cvv, amount): logger.info(f"Processing payment: card={card_number}, cvv={cvv}") logger.error(f"Failed for user: {user.email}, password={password}") # ✅ FIXED - Mask sensitive data def mask_card(card_number: str) -> str: return f"****-****-****-{card_number[-4:]}" def process_payment(card_number, cvv, amount): logger.info(f"Processing payment: card={mask_card(card_number)}, amount={amount}") # ✅ Add a log filter for automatic scrubbing class SensitiveDataFilter(logging.Filter): PATTERNS = [ (r'\b\d{16}\b', '****-****-****-####'), # Credit cards (r'password=[^\s&]+', 'password=[REDACTED]'), # Passwords in URLs (r'Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]+=*', 'Bearer [REDACTED]'), # Tokens ] def filter(self, record): import re message = record.getMessage() for pattern, replacement in self.PATTERNS: message = re.sub(pattern, replacement, message) record.msg = message record.args = () return True logger.addFilter(SensitiveDataFilter()) ``` --- ## 🟡 Medium Severity Issues ### 8. Missing Security Headers ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE - No security headers @app.after_request def add_headers(response): return response # Missing all security headers # ✅ FIXED from flask_talisman import Talisman csp = { "default-src": "'self'", "script-src": ["'self'", "trusted-cdn.com"], "style-src": ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"], # Refine further if possible "img-src": ["'self'", "data:"], "connect-src": "'self'", "frame-ancestors": "'none'", } Talisman( app, content_security_policy=csp, strict_transport_security=True, strict_transport_security_max_age=31536000, referrer_policy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin", ) @app.after_request def add_security_headers(response): response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff" response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY" response.headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "geolocation=(), microphone=()" response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store" # For sensitive endpoints return response ``` ### 9. Insecure JWT Handling ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE import jwt # Weak secret, algorithm confusion attack possible token = jwt.encode({"user_id": user_id}, "secret", algorithm="HS256") # ❌ Not verifying algorithm decoded = jwt.decode(token, "secret", algorithms=["none", "HS256"]) # ✅ FIXED import secrets from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone JWT_SECRET = os.getenv("JWT_SECRET") # Strong secret from env if not JWT_SECRET or len(JWT_SECRET) < 32: raise ValueError("JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters") def create_token(user_id: int, expiry_minutes: int = 15) -> str: payload = { "sub": str(user_id), "iat": datetime.now(timezone.utc), "exp": datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=expiry_minutes), "jti": secrets.token_hex(16), # Unique token ID for revocation } return jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SECRET, algorithm="HS256") def verify_token(token: str) -> dict: try: return jwt.decode( token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=["HS256"], # Explicit, no "none" options={"require": ["exp", "iat", "sub"]}, ) except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError: raise AuthError("Token expired") except jwt.InvalidTokenError: raise AuthError("Invalid token") ``` ### 10. Mass Assignment Vulnerability ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE - Blindly trusting user input @app.route("/users/", methods=["PUT"]) @login_required def update_user(user_id): user = User.query.get_or_404(user_id) user.update(**request.json) # User could set is_admin=True! db.session.commit() # ✅ FIXED - Explicit allowlist from marshmallow import Schema, fields, validate class UserUpdateSchema(Schema): name = fields.Str(validate=validate.Length(min=1, max=100)) email = fields.Email() bio = fields.Str(validate=validate.Length(max=500)) # NOTE: is_admin, role, etc. are NOT included @app.route("/users/", methods=["PUT"]) @login_required def update_user(user_id): if current_user.id != user_id: return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden"}), 403 schema = UserUpdateSchema() try: data = schema.load(request.json) except ValidationError as e: return jsonify({"errors": e.messages}), 400 user = User.query.get_or_404(user_id) for key, value in data.items(): setattr(user, key, value) db.session.commit() ``` --- ## 🔵 Additional Security Improvements ### 11. CSRF Protection ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE - No CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints @app.route("/transfer", methods=["POST"]) @login_required def transfer(): amount = request.form["amount"] to_account = request.form["to_account"] # Executes without verifying request origin # ✅ FIXED from flask_wtf.csrf import CSRFProtect, validate_csrf from wtforms.validators import ValidationError csrf = CSRFProtect(app) app.config["WTF_CSRF_TIME_LIMIT"] = 3600 # 1 hour app.config["WTF_CSRF_SSL_STRICT"] = True # For REST APIs using custom header @app.route("/api/transfer", methods=["POST"]) @login_required def transfer(): try: validate_csrf(request.headers.get("X-CSRFToken")) except ValidationError: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid CSRF token"}), 403 ``` ### 12. Dependency Security ```bash # Audit dependencies regularly pip install pip-audit safety pip-audit safety check # Pin exact versions in production pip freeze > requirements.txt # Use GitHub Dependabot or Snyk in CI/CD # .github/dependabot.yml ``` ```yaml # .github/dependabot.yml version: 2 updates: - package-ecosystem: "pip" directory: "/" schedule: interval: "weekly" open-pull-requests-limit: 10 ``` ### 13. Secure Session Configuration ```python # ❌ VULNERABLE app.config["SECRET_KEY"] = "dev" app.config["SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE"] = False # ✅ FIXED app.config.update( SECRET_KEY=os.getenv("SECRET_KEY"), SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=True, # HTTPS only SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY=True, # No JS access SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE="Strict", # CSRF protection PERMANENT_SESSION_LIFETIME=timedelta(hours=1), SESSION_COOKIE_NAME="__Host-session", # __Host prefix for extra security ) ``` --- ## Security Checklist Summary ``` Authentication & Authorization ├── [ ] Strong password hashing (bcrypt/argon2) ├── [ ] Rate limiting on auth endpoints ├── [ ] MFA support ├── [ ] JWT with short expiry + refresh tokens ├── [ ] Ownership checks on all resource access └── [ ] Principle of least privilege on roles Input Handling ├── [ ] Parameterized queries (no SQL injection) ├── [ ] Input validation with allowlists ├── [ ] Output encoding (XSS prevention) ├── [ ] File upload validation (type, size, content) └── [ ] No mass assignment Data Protection ├── [ ] Secrets in environment variables ├── [ ] Sensitive data masked in logs ├── [ ] Encryption at rest for PII ├── [ ] TLS 1.2+ enforced └── [ ] Secure session cookies Infrastructure ├── [ ] Security headers configured ├── [ ] CSRF protection enabled ├── [ ] Dependencies audited and pinned ├── [ ] Error messages don't leak internals └── [ ] Security scanning in CI/CD pipeline ``` --- **Want me to review a specific codebase or technology stack?** Paste your code and I can give targeted, precise recommendations.
